description: Open-source, self-hostable control and execution plane for durable, multi-runtime agents.
rules: Use Enbor as infrastructure behind an agent product, not as an end-user agent application.
Prefer the stable SDK resource facades over generated low-level operations.
Use the SDK guides for integration patterns and the generated OpenAPI document for exact schemas.
For live Enbor operations, use the operate-enbor Skill and discover the current operation through Realmroot Toolbox.
Context7 provides knowledge; it does not authenticate to Enbor or execute operations.
Always configure the Enbor Project id when calling project-scoped resources.
Never put Realmroot access tokens in Agent configuration, Session prompts, or committed source files.
